name: Intel Xeon 6972P specifications
notes: Intel ARK spec page. 96 cores / 192 threads, 2.4 GHz base, 3.5 GHz all-core turbo, 3.9 GHz max turbo, 480 MB cache, TDP 500 W (SST-PP also lists a 400 W / 2.0 GHz profile), 6 UPI at 24 GT/s, 12 memory channels, DDR5-6400 and MRDIMM-8800, max memory 3 TB, FCLGA7529, scalability 2S, 96 PCIe 5.0 lanes, AMX present, lithography Intel 3, launch Q3'24, RCP $11,446. Wikipedia's Granite Rapids table truncates this row's TDP; the ARK page is the one used.
